source: CALCE PL pouch-cell aging data (0-60% SOC, C/2; PL03 and PL10)

documented_test_conditions.reference_performance_test: Full CCCV charge / CC discharge at C/2 between 4.2 V and 2.75 V, described every 50 or 100 partial cycles.

documented_measurements.current: A; positive for charge and negative for discharge

cycle_level_quality_checks.recorded_units: documented in included Readme.txt; raw data values not decoded
cycle_level_quality_checks.data_missing_operation_blocks: 2 per battery explicitly identified in the operation labels; included Readme attributes missing operations to a test-system software fault

candidate_soh_definition.definition: 100 * measured capacity from a verified full C/2 characterization discharge (4.2 V to 2.75 V) / the first verified full characterization discharge capacity for that cell

decode_blocker.observed_data_representation: scipy.io.loadmat reads each operation's Data element as a scipy.io.matlab.MatlabOpaque MCOS table object
decode_blocker.available_reader_status: No MATLAB, Octave, h5py, mat73, hdf5storage, pymatreader, or mat4py is available in the configured environment.
decode_blocker.consequence: The measurement rows are not decoded; no cycle-level processed table, target labels, or training-ready quality report is produced.

terms: The official CALCE page describes its experimental data as open access and requests citation for publication use. No dataset-specific reuse license was identified; no redistribution rights are inferred.
